text:
Alex M: Quick sync — planning a SOFT cutover for SDK v28 next Tue 05:30 PT. Quiet window deploy, not a forced breaking change, but new client binding will default off and a telemetry opt-in flag will be available. Owners: Jon (canaries), Priya (rollback), Lina (docs), Sam (client comms).
Priya R: Ack — I'll prep rollback playbook and standby during the window. What's our target canary %?
Jon K: Recommend 1% for first 30m, then 5% for 30m, then 25% if no alerts. Will monitor 95th latency, error-rate, and model-fallbacks.
Lina C: Docs draft is ready at https://repo/docs/sdk/v28-diff — will finalize single-line upgrade note and migration example.
Sam D: I'll send a short client advisory (one-sentence breaking? none) and a follow-up email to PLG customers. Suggest adding a note about the telemetry opt-in default.
Alex M: Good. Add SLO smoke checks: token latency < 120ms p95, error-rate < 0.5% for canaries. If either breaches, rollback.
Jon K: Adding canary smoke script to the canary-runner:
```bash
# run against canary bucket
curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke text"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN"
```
Jon K: Script posts metrics to /canary-metrics automatically. I'll wire alerts to #eng-oncall.
SRE-Bot: deploy-scheduler: Proposed window reserved Tue 05:30-07:00 PT. Use /deploy confirm to lock.
Priya R: Confirming rollback steps: 1) flip routing to v27 variant, 2) revoke canary tokens, 3) run smoke sweep, 4) patch release notes. I'll paste playbook in thread before deploy.
Lina C: Docs-Bot, please create a short banner in console for opt-in telemetry and link to privacy FAQ.
Docs-Bot: created draft banner card -> https://console/docs/banner/v28-optin (reviewers: Lina, Legal)
Sam D: Client comms copy: "SDK v28: non-breaking release. New optional telemetry flag enabled per opt-in. Update recommended for TLS fixes." I'll post to customers 24h before.
Alex M: One last ask — add a quick test to the SDK CI that toggles the opt-in flag and verifies no behavior change when disabled. Small unit test ok.
Jon K: I'll add test in canary-runner and notify when CI green.
Priya R: I'll be oncall for escalation and have rollback ready. If anything odd, ping @oncall-sre and I'll trigger the flip.
Alex M: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll lock the window. :thumbsup:
Sam D: no objections from product side.
Jon K: no blockers from runtime.
Lina C: docs sign-off pending legal review, but ok to proceed with lock.
SRE-Bot: deploy-scheduler: /deploy confirm received by @alexm at 1749991600 -> window locked.
